brief: Prioritise Penrose Park for pre-event attention and complete outstanding work falling into categories 1 to 3 before the event begins wherever crew capacity allows [SOP-016]. For any ageing unit with a history of high loading that cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Where forced cooling is partially unavailable, reduce permissible load in proportion to the cooling capacity lost in addition to ambient de-rating [MG-021].
